Cc: maya.singh <maya.singh@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: RFP for Azure private plan — scope + timelines

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. The execs are interested in moving forward with an Azure private plan (data residency + dedicated capacity for inference) but procurement needs a concise MA and commercial terms to present to their purchasing committee.

Attached is our RFP (Helix_RFP_v3.pdf) with the high-level usage profile and security attachments they expect. The three things procurement wants clarified before we kick off SOW/PO: 1) billing model for committed capacity and overage, 2) data retention and audit log export cadence, 3) termination / transition support (export of KV caches + model checkpoints).

Can you send a short mutual action plan and a term sheet we can route for signature? Our target is to have a signed private plan agreement and initial PO by 2026-12-10.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Cloud Architecture | Helix Health

Subject: Re: RFP for Azure private plan — scope + timelines

Sanjay — great to hear the execs are aligned. I've looped in Ben (sales lead) and Irene (legal ops) so we can get you a concise MA + term sheet tomorrow.

Immediate next steps I propose:
- We send a 1-page Mutual Action Plan (dates + milestones) by EOD Fri 11/27.
- Draft term sheet (commercials + Azure private plan addendum) for your procurement review by Mon 11/29.
- Parallel: Irene will flag any non-standard legal asks in the RFP (SOC2 scope, export/transition clauses) so you have a redline-ready doc.

Questions for procurement (so we can be precise):
1) Expected committed vCPU/GPU baseline and monthly token estimate?
2) Any specific SLA percentiles beyond 99.9%?
3) Which Helix environment (prod vs. prod+dr) needs private placement initially?

If you can confirm the three items above, we can lock the MA dates.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@helixhealth.com>, maya.singh <maya.singh@helixhealth.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: RFP for Azure private plan — scope + timelines

Quick update — attaching the draft term sheet and a statement of work stub with two commercial options: Committed Reserved Pool (12-month term) and Pay-As-You-Go burst overlay. Key commercial highlights in the term sheet:
- Committed monthly GPU hours with a floor and a defined overage rate (per vGPU-hour).
- Tiered quantization/latency profiles (we'll assign a performance profile to the Helix workload after a short performance run).
- Transition assistance: 30 days of export/hand-off support included for private plan termination; extended transition is billable.

Irene — can you confirm the proposed data retention export clause and whether the 30-day export window is sufficient for health-regulated customers? Also flag anything in the RFP that requires an exception.

Sanjay / Maya — leaving the numbers blank for now — if you can confirm baseline committed GPU hours and whether you need a dedicated DR region we can populate final pricing.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-draft-HLX.docx (draft)]

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@helixhealth.com>, maya.singh <maya.singh@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: RE: RFP for Azure private plan — scope + timelines

Ben / Marissa — I reviewed the RFP and the draft term sheet. Notes:
- Data retention/export: 30 days for KV/keys + audit log bundle is acceptable as a standard. For Helix (PHI remit), recommend adding an optional 60-day extended export assistance (professional services line item).
- SLA: 99.9% is our standard for private plans; if they require 99.95% we need an uplift and a different commitment on reserved vs. burst capacity.
- Security evidence: we'll include SOC 2 Type II attestation and an encrypted audit log export process.
- IP / Model artifacts: we do not transfer model weights; we will provide KV cache exports and inference logs as structured export.

I am OK with the MA milestones (deliver the MA and term sheet today). I've attached inline redlines to Redwood_TermSheet_HLX_v1.docx and a short SOW template. Once Sanjay confirms committed GPU hours and whether DR is required, we can finish pricing and route for DocuSign.

Irene Choi
Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
